integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from the published extreme-point reduction. Finite enumeration in the companion script is only a sanity check and is not treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional real ell-infinity spaces only; the proof and claim cover finite real parameters t >= 1. The t < 1 and infinite-dimensional cases are not asserted.
title: Exact pointwise James profile of finite-dimensional \(\ell_\infty^n\)
